::: {.hero-section}

A **26-lecture** course that builds the modern deep-learning stack from the ground up — from the probability under every loss, through CNNs and Transformers, to LLMs, diffusion, and 2026 frontier topics.

Lectures **1–15 map onto Andrew Ng's [Deep Learning Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/deep-learning)** — watch his videos and re-derive them here. Lectures **16–26** carry the same method into the modern topics he never taught. Every deck is a self-contained **80 minutes**: an output-first opener, one worked idea per slide, practice problems with solutions, and linked interactives, notebooks, and references.

Start with **[Lecture 1 · Probability & the Language of Losses](html/L01-probability-primer.html)**, or browse the full **[Slides](slides.qmd)**.

## The arc

Seven modules, 26 lectures. The first four are Andrew Ng's five courses, re-taught; the last three take his method past where his curriculum ends.

- **Module 1 · Foundations** · *L1–L4* — probability & losses, the neuron, universal approximation, and backprop (build micrograd). *(Ng Course 1)*
- **Module 2 · Optimization & Training** · *L5–L8* — SGD → Adam, regularization & normalization, and the practitioner's playbook (bias/variance, debugging, error analysis). *(Ng Courses 2 & 3)*
- **Module 3 · Computer Vision** · *L9–L11* — CNNs, ResNet & transfer learning, detection & segmentation. *(Ng Course 4)*
- **Module 4 · Sequences & Transformers** · *L12–L15* — RNN/LSTM → seq2seq & embeddings → attention → the Transformer, built live as nanoGPT. *(Ng Course 5)*
- **Module 5 · Modern LLMs & Multimodal** · *L16–L20* — tokenization & pretraining, scaling & systems, alignment (RLHF/DPO), self-supervised learning, and vision-language models.
- **Module 6 · Generative Modeling** · *L21–L24* — autoencoders & VAEs, GANs, and diffusion (theory → Stable Diffusion).
- **Module 7 · Systems & Frontier** · *L25–L26* — efficient training & inference, then the frontier: agents, reasoning, and interpretability.

The full schedule with slide links is on the **[Slides](slides.qmd)** page.

## What you'll build

Two code threads run end-to-end through the course:

- **Language** · micrograd → MLP → Transformer → nanoGPT → LoRA fine-tune
- **Vision** · MLP-MNIST → CNN-CIFAR → transfer-ResNet → ViT-CLIP → diffusion

Running examples · cat / not-cat · MNIST · CIFAR-10 · Tiny Shakespeare · CelebA.
